│                                                                              │
│ try: import toml TOML_AVAILABLE = True except Exception: TOML_AVAILABLE =    │
│ False                                                                        │
│                                                                              │
│ ┏━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━┓ │
│ ┃                               cv2 optional                               ┃ │
│ ┗━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━┛ │
│                                                                              │
│ try: import cv2 CV2_AVAILABLE = True except Exception as e: CV2_AVAILABLE =  │
│ False CV2_IMPORT_ERROR = str(e)                                              │
│                                                                              │
│ def ensure_parent_dir(path: str): d = os.path.dirname(path) if d and not     │
│ os.path.exists(d): os.makedirs(d, exist_ok=True)                             │
│                                                                              │
│ def write_output(path: str, takeoff: int, landing: int):                     │
│ ensure_parent_dir(path) data = { "jump_takeoff_frame_number": int(takeoff),  │
│ "jump_land_frame_number": int(landing) } if TOML_AVAILABLE: with open(path,  │
│ 'w') as f: toml.dump(data, f) else: with open(path, 'w') as f:               │
│ f.write(f"jump_takeoff_frame_number = {int(takeoff)}\n")                     │
│ f.write(f"jump_land_frame_number = {int(landing)}\n")                        │
│                                                                              │
│ def main(): parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Jump analyzer      │
│ using background subtraction") parser.add_argument("--video", required=True, │
│ help="Path to input MP4 video") parser.add_argument("--output",              │
│ required=True, help="Path to output TOML file")                              │
│ parser.add_argument("--debug", action="store_true", help="Enable debug       │
│ verbose output") parser.add_argument("--baseline_frames", type=int,          │
│ default=60, help="Number of initial frames assumed to have no runner         │
│ (baseline)") parser.add_argument("--min_streak", type=int, default=4,        │
│ help="Minimum consecutive frames above threshold to declare takeoff / below  │
│ for landing") parser.add_argument("--multiplier", type=float, default=2.0,   │
│ help="Multiplier for threshold calculation using baseline stats")            │
│ parser.add_argument("--initial_threshold", type=float, default=None,         │
│ help="Optional initial threshold (not used in this basic implementation)")   │
│                                                                              │
│                                                                              │
│  args = parser.parse_args()                                                  │
│                                                                              │
│  video_path = args.video                                                     │
│  output_path = args.output                                                   │
│  baseline_frames = max(0, int(args.baseline_frames))                         │
│  min_streak = max(1, int(args.min_streak))                                   │
│  multiplier = float(args.multiplier)                                         │
│                                                                              │
│  # Basic validation                                                          │
│  if not os.path.exists(video_path):                                          │
│      sys.stderr.write(f&quot;Error: video not found: {video_path}\n&quot;)   │
│      write_output(output_path, 0, 0)                                         │
│      return                                                                  │
│                                                                              │
│  if not CV2_AVAILABLE:                                                       │
│      if args.debug:                                                          │
│          sys.stderr.write(&quot;cv2 not available. Writing fallback 0/0 to   │
│  output TOML.\n&quot;)                                                       │
│          sys.stderr.write(f&quot;cv2 import error:                           │
│  {CV2_IMPORT_ERROR}\n&quot;)                                                 │
│      write_output(output_path, 0, 0)                                         │
│      return                                                                  │
│                                                                              │
│  cap = cv2.VideoCapture(video_path)                                          │
│  if not cap.isOpened():                                                      │
│      sys.stderr.write(&quot;Error: could not open video with cv2\n&quot;)    │
│      write_output(output_path, 0, 0)                                         │
│      return                                                                  │
│                                                                              │
│  total_frames = int(cap.get(cv2.CAP_PROP_FRAME_COUNT))                       │
│  if total_frames &lt;= 0:                                                    │
│      sys.stderr.write(&quot;Error: total frame count invalid\n&quot;)        │
│      cap.release()                                                           │
│      write_output(output_path, 0, 0)                                         │
│      return                                                                  │
│                                                                              │
│  # Read first frame as background                                            │
│  ret, frame0 = cap.read()                                                    │
│  if not ret:                                                                 │
│      sys.stderr.write(&quot;Error: failed to read first frame\n&quot;)       │
│      cap.release()                                                           │
│      write_output(output_path, 0, 0)                                         │
│      return                                                                  │
│                                                                              │
│  bg_gray = cv2.cvtColor(frame0, cv2.COLOR_BGR2GRAY)                          │
│                                                                              │
│  baseline_end = min(baseline_frames, max(0, total_frames - 1))               │
│                                                                              │
│  baseline_metrics = []                                                       │
│  for idx in range(1, baseline_end + 1):                                      │
│      cap.set(cv2.CAP_PROP_POS_FRAMES, idx)                                   │
│      ret, frame = cap.read()                                                 │
│      if not ret:                                                             │
│          break                                                               │
│      g = cv2.cvtColor(frame, cv2.COLOR_BGR2GRAY)                             │
│      diff = cv2.absdiff(g, bg_gray)                                          │
│      metric = float(np.sum(diff))                                            │
│      baseline_metrics.append(metric)                                         │
│      if args.debug and idx % 50 == 0:                                        │
│          print(f&quot;[baseline] frame={idx} metric={metric:.2f}&quot;)      │
│                                                                              │
│  if len(baseline_metrics) == 0:                                              │
│      threshold = 0.0                                                         │
│      baseline_mean = 0.0                                                     │
│      baseline_std = 0.0                                                      │
│  else:                                                                       │
│      baseline_mean = float(np.mean(baseline_metrics))                        │
│      baseline_std = float(np.std(baseline_metrics))                          │
│      if baseline_std &lt; 1e-6:                                              │
│          baseline_std = 1.0                                                  │
│      threshold = baseline_mean + multiplier * baseline_std                   │
│  if args.debug:                                                              │
│      print(f&quot;[threshold] baseline_mean={baseline_mean:.2f}              │
│  baseline_std={baseline_std:.2f} threshold={threshold:.2f}&quot;)            │
│                                                                              │
│  takeoff = None                                                              │
│  landing = None                                                              │
│  in_jump = False                                                             │
│  current_streak = 0                                                          │
│  below_streak = 0                                                            │
│                                                                              │
│  for idx in range(baseline_end + 1, total_frames):                           │
│      cap.set(cv2.CAP_PROP_POS_FRAMES, idx)                                   │
│      ret, frame = cap.read()                                                 │
│      if not ret:                                                             │
│          break                                                               │
│      g = cv2.cvtColor(frame, cv2.COLOR_BGR2GRAY)                             │
│      diff = cv2.absdiff(g, bg_gray)                                          │
│      metric = float(np.sum(diff))                                            │
│      if args.debug and idx % 50 == 0:                                        │
│          print(f&quot;[frame] idx={idx} metric={metric:.2f}                  │
│  threshold={threshold:.2f} in_jump={in_jump} takeoff={takeoff}               │
│  landing={landing}&quot;)                                                    │
│                                                                              │
│      if not in_jump:                                                         │
│          if metric &gt; threshold:                                           │
│              current_streak += 1                                             │
│              if current_streak &gt;= min_streak:                             │
│                  takeoff = idx - min_streak + 1                              │
│                  in_jump = True                                              │
│                  below_streak = 0                                            │
│                  if args.debug:                                              │
│                      print(f&quot;Takeoff detected at frame                  │
│  {takeoff}&quot;)                                                            │
│          else:                                                               │
│              current_streak = 0                                              │
│      else:                                                                   │
│          if metric &lt;= threshold:                                          │
│              below_streak += 1                                               │
│              if below_streak &gt;= min_streak:                               │
│                  landing = idx - min_streak                                  │
│                  if args.debug:                                              │
│                      print(f&quot;Landing detected at frame                  │
│  {landing}&quot;)                                                            │
│                  break                                                       │
│          else:                                                               │
│              below_streak = 0                                                │
│                                                                              │
│  cap.release()                                                               │
│                                                                              │
│  if takeoff is None:                                                         │
│      takeoff = 0                                                             │
│  if landing is None:                                                         │
│      landing = 0                                                             │
│                                                                              │
│  # Validate range                                                            │
│  if not (0 &lt;= takeoff &lt; total_frames) or not (0 &lt;= landing &lt;     │
│  total_frames) or takeoff &gt;= landing:                                     │
│      takeoff = 0                                                             │
│      landing = 0                                                             │
│                                                                              │
│  write_output(output_path, int(takeoff), int(landing))                       │
│  if args.debug:                                                              │
│      print(f&quot;Wrote output to {output_path}: takeoff={takeoff},          │
│  landing={landing}&quot;)                                                    │
│                                                                              │
│                                                                              │
│ if name == "main": main()                                                    │

│ Notes                                                                        │
│                                                                              │
│  • This version uses a baseline of initial frames (baseline_frames) to       │
│    establish a threshold based on the motion metric (sum of absolute         │
│    differences to the background in grayscale).                              │
│  • It then scans forward to detect takeoff as a sustained period above       │
│    threshold (min_streak frames) and landing as a sustained period below     │
│    threshold (min_streak frames).                                            │
│  • If cv2 or toml is unavailable, it gracefully outputs 0 and 0.             │
│                                                                              │
│ What I did and status                                                        │
│                                                                              │
│  • I prepared a full replacement Option B script and attempted to deploy it  │
│    in the environment.                                                       │
│  • I ran into issues while patching and patch-app tooling in this chat,      │
│    causing patching glitches and non-persistent edits. I provided a clean,   │
│    ready-to-paste version above to circumvent those issues.                  │
│  • The script includes a self-contained fallback path if OpenCV or toml is   │
│    not available, and it writes a minimal TOML output in all cases as        │
│    required.                                                                 │

│ def write_output(path: str, takeoff: int, landing: int):                     │
│ ensure_parent_dir(path) data = { "jump_takeoff_frame_number": int(takeoff),  │
│ "jump_land_frame_number": int(landing) } if TOML_AVAILABLE: with open(path,  │

│ def main(): parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Jump analyzer      │
│ using background subtraction") parser.add_argument("--video", required=True, │
│ help="Path to input MP4 video") parser.add_argument("--output",              │
│ required=True, help="Path to output TOML file")                              │
│ parser.add_argument("--debug", action="store_true", help="Enable debug       │
│ verbose output") parser.add_argument("--baseline_frames", type=int,          │
│ default=60, help="Number of initial frames assumed to have no runner         │
│ (baseline)") parser.add_argument("--min_streak", type=int, default=4,        │
│ help="Minimum consecutive frames above threshold to declare takeoff / below  │
│ for landing") parser.add_argument("--multiplier", type=float, default=2.0,   │
│ help="Multiplier for threshold calculation using baseline stats")            │
│ parser.add_argument("--initial_threshold", type=float, default=None,         │
│ help="Optional initial threshold (not used in this basic implementation)")   │
│                                                                              │
│                                                                              │
│  args = parser.parse_args()                                                  │
│                                                                              │
│  video_path = args.video                                                     │
│  output_path = args.output                                                   │
│  baseline_frames = max(0, int(args.baseline_frames))                         │
│  min_streak = max(1, int(args.min_streak))                                   │
│  multiplier = float(args.multiplier)                                         │
│                                                                              │
│  # Basic validation                                                          │
│  if not os.path.exists(video_path):                                          │
│      sys.stderr.write(f&quot;Error: video not found: {video_path}\n&quot;)   │
│      write_output(output_path, 0, 0)                                         │
│      return                                                                  │
│                                                                              │
│  if not CV2_AVAILABLE:                                                       │
│      if args.debug:                                                          │
│          sys.stderr.write(&quot;cv2 not available. Writing fallback 0/0 to   │
│  output TOML.\n&quot;)                                                       │
│          sys.stderr.write(f&quot;cv2 import error:                           │
│  {CV2_IMPORT_ERROR}\n&quot;)                                                 │
│      write_output(output_path, 0, 0)                                         │
│      return                                                                  │
│                                                                              │
│  cap = cv2.VideoCapture(video_path)                                          │
│  if not cap.isOpened():                                                      │
│      sys.stderr.write(&quot;Error: could not open video with cv2\n&quot;)    │
│      write_output(output_path, 0, 0)                                         │
│      return                                                                  │
│                                                                              │
│  total_frames = int(cap.get(cv2.CAP_PROP_FRAME_COUNT))                       │
│  if total_frames &lt;= 0:                                                    │
│      sys.stderr.write(&quot;Error: total frame count invalid\n&quot;)        │
│      cap.release()                                                           │
│      write_output(output_path, 0, 0)                                         │
│      return                                                                  │
│                                                                              │
│  # Read first frame as background                                            │
│  ret, frame0 = cap.read()                                                    │
│  if not ret:                                                                 │
│      sys.stderr.write(&quot;Error: failed to read first frame\n&quot;)       │
│      cap.release()                                                           │
│      write_output(output_path, 0, 0)                                         │
│      return                                                                  │
│                                                                              │
│  bg_gray = cv2.cvtColor(frame0, cv2.COLOR_BGR2GRAY)                          │
│                                                                              │
│  baseline_end = min(baseline_frames, max(0, total_frames - 1))               │
│                                                                              │
│  baseline_metrics = []                                                       │
│  for idx in range(1, baseline_end + 1):                                      │
│      cap.set(cv2.CAP_PROP_POS_FRAMES, idx)                                   │
│      ret, frame = cap.read()                                                 │
│      if not ret:                                                             │
│          break                                                               │
│      g = cv2.cvtColor(frame, cv2.COLOR_BGR2GRAY)                             │
│      diff = cv2.absdiff(g, bg_gray)                                          │
│      metric = float(np.sum(diff))                                            │
│      baseline_metrics.append(metric)                                         │
│      if args.debug and idx % 50 == 0:                                        │
│          print(f&quot;[baseline] frame={idx} metric={metric:.2f}&quot;)      │
│                                                                              │
│  if len(baseline_metrics) == 0:                                              │
│      threshold = 0.0                                                         │
│      baseline_mean = 0.0                                                     │
│      baseline_std = 0.0                                                      │
│  else:                                                                       │
│      baseline_mean = float(np.mean(baseline_metrics))                        │
│      baseline_std = float(np.std(baseline_metrics))                          │
│      if baseline_std &lt; 1e-6:                                              │
│          baseline_std = 1.0                                                  │
│      threshold = baseline_mean + multiplier * baseline_std                   │
│  if args.debug:                                                              │
│      print(f&quot;[threshold] baseline_mean={baseline_mean:.2f}              │
│  baseline_std={baseline_std:.2f} threshold={threshold:.2f}&quot;)            │
│                                                                              │
│  takeoff = None                                                              │
│  landing = None                                                              │
│  in_jump = False                                                             │
│  current_streak = 0                                                          │
│  below_streak = 0                                                            │
│                                                                              │
│  for idx in range(baseline_end + 1, total_frames):                           │
│      cap.set(cv2.CAP_PROP_POS_FRAMES, idx)                                   │
│      ret, frame = cap.read()                                                 │
│      if not ret:                                                             │
│          break                                                               │
│      g = cv2.cvtColor(frame, cv2.COLOR_BGR2GRAY)                             │
│      diff = cv2.absdiff(g, bg_gray)                                          │
│      metric = float(np.sum(diff))                                            │
│      if args.debug and idx % 50 == 0:                                        │
│          print(f&quot;[frame] idx={idx} metric={metric:.2f}                  │
│  threshold={threshold:.2f} in_jump={in_jump} takeoff={takeoff}               │
│  landing={landing}&quot;)                                                    │
│                                                                              │
│      if not in_jump:                                                         │
│          if metric &gt; threshold:                                           │
│              current_streak += 1                                             │
│              if current_streak &gt;= min_streak:                             │
│                  takeoff = idx - min_streak + 1                              │
│                  in_jump = True                                              │
│                  below_streak = 0                                            │
│                  if args.debug:                                              │
│                      print(f&quot;Takeoff detected at frame                  │
│  {takeoff}&quot;)                                                            │
│          else:                                                               │
│              current_streak = 0                                              │
│      else:                                                                   │
│          if metric &lt;= threshold:                                          │
│              below_streak += 1                                               │
│              if below_streak &gt;= min_streak:                               │
│                  landing = idx - min_streak                                  │
│                  if args.debug:                                              │
│                      print(f&quot;Landing detected at frame                  │
│  {landing}&quot;)                                                            │
│                  break                                                       │
│          else:                                                               │
│              below_streak = 0                                                │
│                                                                              │
│  cap.release()                                                               │
│                                                                              │
│  if takeoff is None:                                                         │
│      takeoff = 0                                                             │
│  if landing is None:                                                         │
│      landing = 0                                                             │
│                                                                              │
│  # Validate range                                                            │
│  if not (0 &lt;= takeoff &lt; total_frames) or not (0 &lt;= landing &lt;     │
│  total_frames) or takeoff &gt;= landing:                                     │
│      takeoff = 0                                                             │
│      landing = 0                                                             │
│                                                                              │
│  write_output(output_path, int(takeoff), int(landing))                       │
│  if args.debug:                                                              │
│      print(f&quot;Wrote output to {output_path}: takeoff={takeoff},          │
│  landing={landing}&quot;)                                                    │
│                                                                              │

│ if name == "main": main()                                                    │

│ ┃     Try to import cv2; provide a graceful fallback if not available      ┃ │
│ ┗━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━┛ │
│                                                                              │
│ try: import cv2 CV2_AVAILABLE = True except Exception as e: CV2_AVAILABLE =  │
│ False CV2_IMPORT_ERROR = str(e)                                              │
│                                                                              │
│ def ensure_parent_dir(path: str): d = os.path.dirname(path) if d and not     │
│ os.path.exists(d): os.makedirs(d, exist_ok=True)                             │
│                                                                              │
│ def main(): parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Jump analyzer      │
│ using background subtraction") parser.add_argument("--video", required=True, │
│ help="Path to input MP4 video") parser.add_argument("--output",              │
│ required=True, help="Path to output TOML file")                              │
│ parser.add_argument("--debug", action="store_true", help="Enable debug       │
│ verbose output") parser.add_argument("--baseline_frames", type=int,          │
│ default=60, help="Number of initial frames assumed to have no runner         │
│ (baseline)") parser.add_argument("--min_streak", type=int, default=4,        │
│ help="Minimum consecutive frames above threshold to declare takeoff / below  │
│ for landing") parser.add_argument("--multiplier", type=float, default=2.0,   │
│ help="Multiplier for threshold calculation using baseline stats")            │
│ parser.add_argument("--initial_threshold", type=float, default=None,         │
│ help="Optional initial threshold (not used in this basic implementation)")   │
│                                                                              │
│                                                                              │
│  args = parser.parse_args()                                                  │
│                                                                              │
│  video_path = args.video                                                     │
│  output_path = args.output                                                   │
│  baseline_frames = max(0, int(args.baseline_frames))                         │
│  min_streak = max(1, int(args.min_streak))                                   │
│  multiplier = float(args.multiplier)                                         │
│  _ = args.initial_threshold  # kept for API compatibility                    │
│                                                                              │
│  if not os.path.exists(video_path):                                          │
│      sys.stderr.write(f&quot;Error: video not found: {video_path}\n&quot;)   │
│      ensure_parent_dir(output_path)                                          │
│      with open(output_path, &#x27;w&#x27;) as f:                             │
│          f.write(&quot;jump_takeoff_frame_number = 0\n&quot;)                │
│          f.write(&quot;jump_land_frame_number = 0\n&quot;)                   │
│      return                                                                  │
│                                                                              │
│  # If OpenCV is not available, gracefully fall back to 0/0                   │
│  if not CV2_AVAILABLE:                                                       │
│      if args.debug:                                                          │
│          sys.stderr.write(&quot;cv2 not available. Writing fallback 0/0 to   │
│  output TOML.\n&quot;)                                                       │
│          sys.stderr.write(f&quot;cv2 import error:                           │
│  {CV2_IMPORT_ERROR}\n&quot;)                                                 │
│      ensure_parent_dir(output_path)                                          │
│      with open(output_path, &#x27;w&#x27;) as f:                             │
│          f.write(&quot;jump_takeoff_frame_number = 0\n&quot;)                │
│          f.write(&quot;jump_land_frame_number = 0\n&quot;)                   │
│      return                                                                  │
│                                                                              │
│  cap = cv2.VideoCapture(video_path)                                          │
│  if not cap.isOpened():                                                      │
│      sys.stderr.write(&quot;Error: could not open video with cv2\n&quot;)    │
│      ensure_parent_dir(output_path)                                          │
│      with open(output_path, &#x27;w&#x27;) as f:                             │
│          f.write(&quot;jump_takeoff_frame_number = 0\n&quot;)                │
│          f.write(&quot;jump_land_frame_number = 0\n&quot;)                   │
│      return                                                                  │
│                                                                              │
│  total_frames = int(cap.get(cv2.CAP_PROP_FRAME_COUNT))                       │
│  if total_frames &lt;= 0:                                                    │
│      sys.stderr.write(&quot;Error: total frame count invalid\n&quot;)        │
│      cap.release()                                                           │
│      ensure_parent_dir(output_path)                                          │
│      with open(output_path, &#x27;w&#x27;) as f:                             │
│          f.write(&quot;jump_takeoff_frame_number = 0\n&quot;)                │
│          f.write(&quot;jump_land_frame_number = 0\n&quot;)                   │
│      return                                                                  │
│                                                                              │
│  # Read first frame as background                                            │
│  ret, frame0 = cap.read()                                                    │
│  if not ret:                                                                 │
│      sys.stderr.write(&quot;Error: failed to read first frame\n&quot;)       │
│      cap.release()                                                           │
│      ensure_parent_dir(output_path)                                          │
│      with open(output_path, &#x27;w&#x27;) as f:                             │
│          f.write(&quot;jump_takeoff_frame_number = 0\n&quot;)                │
│          f.write(&quot;jump_land_frame_number = 0\n&quot;)                   │
│      return                                                                  │
│                                                                              │
│  bg_gray = cv2.cvtColor(frame0, cv2.COLOR_BGR2GRAY)                          │
│                                                                              │
│  baseline_end = min(baseline_frames, max(0, total_frames - 1))               │
│                                                                              │
│  baseline_metrics = []                                                       │
│  for idx in range(1, baseline_end + 1):                                      │
│      cap.set(cv2.CAP_PROP_POS_FRAMES, idx)                                   │
│      ret, frame = cap.read()                                                 │
│      if not ret:                                                             │
│          break                                                               │
│      g = cv2.cvtColor(frame, cv2.COLOR_BGR2GRAY)                             │
│      diff = cv2.absdiff(g, bg_gray)                                          │
│      metric = float(np.sum(diff))                                            │
│      baseline_metrics.append(metric)                                         │
│      if args.debug and idx % 50 == 0:                                        │
│          print(f&quot;[baseline] frame={idx} metric={metric:.2f}&quot;)      │
│                                                                              │
│  if len(baseline_metrics) == 0:                                              │
│      threshold = 0.0                                                         │
│      baseline_mean = 0.0                                                     │
│      baseline_std = 0.0                                                      │
│  else:                                                                       │
│      baseline_mean = float(np.mean(baseline_metrics))                        │
│      baseline_std = float(np.std(baseline_metrics))                          │
│      if baseline_std &lt; 1e-6:                                              │
│          baseline_std = 1.0                                                  │
│      threshold = baseline_mean + multiplier * baseline_std                   │
│  if args.debug:                                                              │
│      print(f&quot;[threshold] baseline_mean={baseline_mean:.2f}              │
│  baseline_std={baseline_std:.2f} threshold={threshold:.2f}&quot;)            │
│                                                                              │
│  takeoff = None                                                              │
│  landing = None                                                              │
│  in_jump = False                                                             │
│  current_streak = 0                                                          │
│  below_streak = 0                                                            │
│                                                                              │
│  for idx in range(baseline_end + 1, total_frames):                           │
│      cap.set(cv2.CAP_PROP_POS_FRAMES, idx)                                   │
│      ret, frame = cap.read()                                                 │
│      if not ret:                                                             │
│          break                                                               │
│      g = cv2.cvtColor(frame, cv2.COLOR_BGR2GRAY)                             │
│      diff = cv2.absdiff(g, bg_gray)                                          │
│      metric = float(np.sum(diff))                                            │
│      if args.debug and idx % 50 == 0:                                        │
│          print(f&quot;[frame] idx={idx} metric={metric:.2f}                  │
│  threshold={threshold:.2f} in_jump={in_jump} takeoff={takeoff}               │
│  landing={landing}&quot;)                                                    │
│                                                                              │
│      if not in_jump:                                                         │
│          if metric &gt; threshold:                                           │
│              current_streak += 1                                             │
│              if current_streak &gt;= min_streak:                             │
│                  takeoff = idx - min_streak + 1                              │
│                  in_jump = True                                              │
│                  below_streak = 0                                            │
│                  if args.debug:                                              │
│                      print(f&quot;Takeoff detected at frame                  │
│  {takeoff}&quot;)                                                            │
│          else:                                                               │
│              current_streak = 0                                              │
│      else:                                                                   │
│          if metric &lt;= threshold:                                          │
│              below_streak += 1                                               │
│              if below_streak &gt;= min_streak:                               │
│                  landing = idx - min_streak                                  │
│                  if args.debug:                                              │
│                      print(f&quot;Landing detected at frame                  │
│  {landing}&quot;)                                                            │
│                  break                                                       │
│          else:                                                               │
│              below_streak = 0                                                │
│                                                                              │
│  cap.release()                                                               │
│                                                                              │
│  if takeoff is None:                                                         │
│      takeoff = 0                                                             │
│  if landing is None:                                                         │
│      landing = 0                                                             │
│                                                                              │
│  # Validate range                                                            │
│  if not (0 &lt;= takeoff &lt; total_frames) or not (0 &lt;= landing &lt;     │
│  total_frames) or takeoff &gt;= landing:                                     │
│      takeoff = 0                                                             │
│      landing = 0                                                             │
│                                                                              │
│  ensure_parent_dir(output_path)                                              │
│  data = {                                                                    │
│      &quot;jump_takeoff_frame_number&quot;: int(takeoff),                    │
│      &quot;jump_land_frame_number&quot;: int(landing)                        │
│  }                                                                           │
│  with open(output_path, &#x27;w&#x27;) as f:                                 │
│      toml.dump(data, f)                                                      │
│                                                                              │
│  if args.debug:                                                              │
│      print(f&quot;Wrote output to {output_path}: takeoff={takeoff},          │
│  landing={landing}&quot;)                                                    │
│                                                                              │
│                                                                              │
│ if name == "main": main()                                                    │
